claim: The video-model literature reinforces that video generation is significantly more energy-intensive than text generation, extending the text-to-image hierarchy even further.
shortLabel: Video generation is another order of magnitude problem
displayValue: Video generation is far above text generation
comparisonContext: This matters for classroom guidance because public 'prompt cost' conversations often ignore non-text AI modalities.
scopeNote: Comparative directional finding; the current evidence does not support one single canonical Wh value for all video models.
